title: Taskbase 2017 — Angular homepage prototype
stack: Angular 5 + Angular Material + d3, @angular/cli 1.x, deployed to Heroku
build: docker node:8 + @angular/cli 1.5.4 (plus @angular-devkit/core@0.0.29, which the 1.5.4 tree is missing): npm install then "ng build --base-href ./". JIT/dev build, not --prod: AOT trips over a typo in the original app.component.html ("sidenaveState" instead of "sidenavState") that JIT tolerates.
notes: Real build of the original Angular 5 source, not a reconstruction. First attempt at a standalone marketing site, in its own GitLab repo. Never the public taskbase.com — superseded by the Feb/Apr 2018 redesign before launch, and it shows: the d3 module selector still carries placeholder copy ("Bla", "Blab", "Blub", "Barf", "Blarb Module is amazing.") straight from the source. Newsletter and contact forms post nowhere. Deep links (team, blog, impressum) work; in-app navigation works too. The old specimen card is kept as specimen.html.
